descriptions.zh: 这个星球上的植物群非常地灵巧，惊人地具有侵略性，绝对值得近距离研究。
descriptions.en: The planet's flora is remarkably dexterous, alarmingly aggressive, and definitely worthy of closer study.

descriptions.zh:
奇怪的信号从卫星上发出。也许什么都不是。

但也可能是重要的东西。利用轨道上的飞船作为通讯中继，殖民地科学家仔细扫描了卫星表面以探查事情的真相。
descriptions.en:
Strange readings are coming from the planet's moon. It could be nothing.

But it could be something. With a ship in orbit acting as a relay, the colony's scientists will carefully scan the moon's surface in order to get to the heart of the matter.

descriptions.zh: 星球的当地的一些植物呈现出许多潜在的有趣特性。
descriptions.en: Some of the planet's native flora exhibit several potentially interesting properties.

descriptions.zh: 最近，名声在外的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]学术中心提出了一些组织大量劳动力的可行方法。一项对这些新方法的彻底研究可以解决在富有挑战性的殖民地环境中生产力衰退的问题。
descriptions.en: Several recent studies from reputable [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] seats of learning present a number of alternative ways of arranging a vast workforce. An exhaustive meta-study of these new ideas could provide the answer to the problem of declining productivity in challenging colony environments.

descriptions.zh:
行星上花粉感染的状况变成了某种潜在的威胁。一项对殖民地状况特别是其愈加不稳定的环境因素的快速评估至关重要。

一旦了解了所有的威胁，可以在几小时内制定并执行一个应对方案。
descriptions.en:
The situation on the pollen-infested planet has taken a turn for the potentially dangerous. A speedy assessment of the colony's unique situation and especially its increasingly volatile environmental factors is of the utmost importance.

Once all threats are known, an action plan can be drafted and executed within hours.

descriptions.zh:
恩赐女神神龛的每一面上都覆盖着由的象形文字组成的复杂网络，似乎在诉说着一个远比[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]的上古传说更加恢弘的故事。

即使只是与已知的古[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]语言有着些许的关系，只要有足够的时间和资源，在当代科技的帮助下，我们也可以解读这些象形文字。
descriptions.en:
Every surface of the Benefactress' shrine is covered with a complex web of pictograms, seemingly telling a story far more expansive than the lingering fables on [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName].

Though only distantly related to known ancient [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] languages: modern technology should allow us to decipher the pictograms, given enough time and resources.

descriptions.zh:
一如萦绕着祂的神话传说，供奉勇气之神神龛的神庙充满了无法确定来源与作用的装置。与简单的谜箱相去甚远，位于[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]的祂的神庙中四处充满着对力量的试炼，传说只有真正的贤者才读到祂的圣言。

我们先进的分析工具应该可以迅速破解这些密码。
descriptions.en:
The temple holding the Undaunted's shrine is - true to the myths surrounding him - filled with contraptions of indeterminate origin and purpose. A far cry from the simple puzzle-boxes and tests of strength that once filled his temples on [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName], it was once claimed that his holy texts could only be read by the truly worthy.

Our sophisticated analysis tools should make short work of these ciphers.

descriptions.zh:
放置着洞察女神神像的洞室，其外墙被一层层厚重的金属漆所覆盖，但神像本身却是光秃秃的。

洞察女神的传说只会告诉那些能够理解这些传说的人——只有足够敏锐的人才能分辨哪些东西是真正需要领会的。
descriptions.en:
The walls housing this shrine to the Percipient are coated with thick layers of a mineral-based lacquer, but the shrine itself is bare.

The tales of the Percipient are told only to those perceptive enough to understand their meaning - it is just a matter of figuring out what needs to be perceived.

descriptions.zh:
随着首席科学官从这个星系毫无征兆的离去，大量令人困惑的残余能量信号随着太阳风被投射出去。

但愿彻底研究这些能量能帮我们找出首席科学家的下一个目的地，甚至，如果有必要，让我们更容易地追踪他。
descriptions.en:
The Chairperson's unseen departure from this system resulted in a perplexing mass of residual energy signatures being cast upon the solar winds.

Hopefully a complete analysis of these energies should point us to the Chairperson's next destination, and if need be, make them easier to track in the future.

descriptions.en: Reconstruct the traumatic past of this celestial body.

descriptions.zh: 一个满载着各种数据存储设备的外星避难所，亟待考古学家恢复数据。
descriptions.en: An alien vault filled with data storage devices practically begs for some archaeological data recovery.

descriptions.zh: 一颗异常的行星和它异常的卫星；常规的技术无法给出满意的探测结果，需要进行更加实地的调查。
descriptions.en: An unusual planet has an unusual moon; the usual scanning techniques do not give satisfactory results, and a more hands-on approach is needed.

links.condition: on_success = { from = { carrier_event = { id = anomaly.191 } } }

descriptions.zh: 如果我们尽快行动，这颗星球上的剧烈变动可能得以稳定，并成为潜在的宜居地。
descriptions.en: The violently animated face of this planet can be stabilized into something potentially habitable, if we act soon.

links.condition: on_success = { ship_event = { id = anomaly.233 } }

descriptions.zh: 一件外星文物被怀疑通过雾化的芳香化合物传输信息。
descriptions.en: An alien artifact is suspected of relaying information through aerosolized aromatic compounds.

links.condition: on_success = { ship_event = { id = anomaly.251 } }

descriptions.zh: 在这个星球的某个地方藏匿着一个武器箱。如果我们能找它，也许我们的帝国可以借此获得新的武器技术。
descriptions.en: A cache of weapons lie hidden somewhere on the planet. If we can find them, they may provide new martial technologies for our Empire.

descriptions.zh: 在轨可控阳电子扩散法也许可以将星球原有的矿物质变成一种更有用的形式。
descriptions.en: Controlled dispersal of positrons from orbit may change the minerals native to the planet into a more useful form.

descriptions.zh: 一项对于这些废墟的最新异种社会考古学研究也许能帮助我们理解这些古代外星战争机器。
descriptions.en: A closer xeno-socio-archaeological study of these ruins may provide insights into some past alien war machine.

descriptions.zh: 一种矿石结阵储存着某种全息编码信息。它的结构很常见，但是其中蕴含的数据密度使得它难以被解密。
descriptions.en: A mineral formation houses hologram-encoded information. Its structure is familiar, but the sheer data density makes it a challenge to decode.

descriptions.zh: 一个杂草丛生的设施也许蕴藏着重要的秘密。
descriptions.en: An overgrown facility may house important secrets.

descriptions.zh: 安排一个科学部门收集并整理太空变形虫的相关数据。
descriptions.en: Task a science department with collecting and collating data relating to the Space Amoebas.

descriptions.zh: 不知为何，我们的舰队似乎会激怒太空变形虫。要是能够确定其原因，也许就能降低变形虫的侵略性，甚至将我们的舰队从其感官中完全屏蔽。
descriptions.en: Something about our fleets seems to agitate the Space Amoebas. If we could somehow isolate what this something is, we could reduce Amoeba aggression or possibly completely mask our ships from their senses.

descriptions.zh: 安排一个科学部门收集并整理晶态实体的相关数据。
descriptions.en: Task a science department with collecting and collating data relating to the Crystalline Entities.

descriptions.zh: 在某些星系中观察到的晶态实体处于不稳定状态，也许会造成危险。
descriptions.en: The Crystalline Entities observed in some systems are volatile and potentially dangerous.

descriptions.zh: 安排一个科学部门收集并整理远古采矿无人机的相关数据。
descriptions.en: Task a science department with collecting and collating data relating to the Ancient Mining Drones.

descriptions.zh: 指派一个科学部门收集并整理虚空之云的相关数据。
descriptions.en: Task a science department with collecting and collating data relating to the Void Clouds.

descriptions.zh:
有一个仅用标准科研船上的设备就能使星球上失衡生态圈恢复平衡的方案被设计了出来。

也许会造成无法预见的后果。
descriptions.en:
A plan has been formulated to attempt to balance the planet's lopsided biosphere using only the tools available to a standard Science Ship.

There may be unforeseen consequences.

descriptions.zh: 可派一支军事舰队尝试打捞这艘一直被掩埋的舰船。
descriptions.en: A military fleet can attempt to salvage an ever-burrowing ship.

descriptions.zh: 一个漂浮在太空的数据库，里面仅仅储存着一篇用陌生但又熟悉的外星文字写成的冗长文章。
descriptions.en: A databank found floating in space houses nothing but a lengthy piece of text, written in a strange, yet familiar, alien language.

descriptions.zh: 我们发现了一个严重受损的物体，这似乎是一个通讯信标。
descriptions.en: A heavily-damaged object seems to act as a repeater for a comms signal.

links.condition: on_success = { ship_event = { id = anomaly.3091 } }

descriptions.zh: 解码碑塔上的信息。
descriptions.en: Decode the message emanating from the monolith.

links.condition: on_success = { owner = { country_event = { id = anomaly.3113 } } }

descriptions.zh: 部署工程队伍修复舰船，使之恢复工作状态。
descriptions.en: Deploy engineering teams to restore the salvageable vessels to working order.

descriptions.zh: 部署工程队伍来修复古代轨道矿场使之恢复工作状态。
descriptions.en: Deploy engineering teams to restore an ancient orbital station to working order.

sections.zh: 轨道上拥有$COUNT$/$REQUIRED$支有指挥官的军事舰队。
sections.en: Has $COUNT$/$REQUIRED$ Military Fleet(s) with a Commander in orbit.
